name: OpenPlay Console
author: OpenPlay Developers
description: The official built-in fullscreen console theme for OpenPlay.

settings.label: Console Accent Color
settings.description: Primary highlight color for focused game covers, active filter presets, and play buttons in Console Mode.

settings.label: Hero Backdrop Dimming
settings.description: Darkness vignette overlaid on full-bleed hero backgrounds for crisp text readability.

settings.label: Hero Backdrop Blur (px)
settings.description: Optional blur applied to hero backgrounds on the Console Home screen (0px keeps sharp cinematic art).

settings.label: Default Console Home Layout
settings.description: Choose whether Console Mode opens on the Horizontal Carousel or directly in the Expanded Cover Grid.

settings.label: Ultrawide Content Width
settings.description: Controls foreground UI safe-zone width on 21:9 and 32:9 ultrawide monitors while hero backdrops always fill edge-to-edge.

settings.label: Cover Card Size
settings.description: Scale of vertical 2:3 Steam-ratio box art cards in the carousel and fullscreen grid.

settings.label: Card Corner Radius
settings.description: Corner roundness for game cover cards in Console Mode.

settings.label: Focused Cover Glow & Zoom
settings.description: Applies luminous accent glow and smooth elevation zoom to the currently focused game cover.
